summary: A fault, nudge or other unlisted claim on a mission run, generation or step refolds only the agents cards that run or step owns or queues, instead of every card in the agents roster

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digests change.

compatibility.detail: Agents cards are unchanged; only which cards a refresh refolds changes.

recovery.detail: In-memory behavior only; a rollback restores whole-roster refolds for these claims without changing durable state.
